newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania central bank reserves rise in October.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania central bank reserves rise in October.

text.p: The official reserves of the central bank of Lithuania rose by 0.8 percent in October to $842.8 million, the bank said on Wednesday.
The bank's amount of convertible foreign currencies rose by $12.5 million, 1.7 percent, to $764.4 million during October, a central bank spokesman said.
Since the start of the year the amount of convertible foreign currencies has risen by 25.5 percent.
The reserves are still below the $852.5 million reached in August, the highest level since Lithuania regained its independence from the former Soviet Union in 1991.
Gold reserves have not changed since the start of the year and stand at $62 million, the spokesman added.
